question: Who is Maharashtra's second deputy chief minister as on October 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajit Pawar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ajit Pawar is a prominent politician from Maharashtra and a senior leader of the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP).
 
• He has held several significant positions in the Maharashtra government, including Deputy Chief Minister.
 
• Ajit Pawar was sworn in as the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra on 2 July 2023.
 
• He is the second Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra in the current government, serving alongside Devendra Fadnavis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra Government Structure**

 
 
• The state government of Maharashtra is headed by the Chief Minister, who is the executive head of the state.
 
• The Deputy Chief Minister assists the Chief Minister in the administration and often handles important portfolios.
 
• The Governor of Maharashtra is the ceremonial head of the state, appointed by the President of India.
 
 
 
• **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)**
 
 
• The NCP was formed on 25 May 1999 by Sharad Pawar, P. A. Sangma, and Tariq Anwar after they were expelled from the Indian National Congress.
 
• The NCP is a centre-left political party in India, mainly active in Maharashtra.
 
• The party's symbol is a clock, and its ideology is based on the principles of secularism and democracy.
 
 
 
• **Political Career of Ajit Pawar**
 
 
• Ajit Pawar is the nephew of Sharad Pawar, the founder of the NCP.
 
• He has served in various capacities in the Maharashtra government, including as Minister of Water Resources and Minister of Finance.
 
• Ajit Pawar has been elected multiple times to the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly from the Baramati constituency.
 
 
 
• **Current Government of Maharashtra (as of October 2023)**
 
 
• The government is a coalition formed by the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP).
 
• Eknath Shinde is the Chief Minister of Maharashtra, leading the coalition government.
 
• Devendra Fadnavis and Ajit Pawar are serving as the Deputy Chief Ministers in this government.
